text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon defeated Tokai Teio in the 
Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Enveloped in roaring cheers, I feel 
delighted knowing that I, too, was able to 
give people courage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, she exchanges a promise 
with Tokai Teio, who still has traces of 
tears on her face, to have a rematch 
someday.
